subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about adding paid referrals on top of your organic comparison-table traffic. The one point worth restating: we run on a cost-per-sale basis, so the fee triggers only on a referral your provider confirms as qualified, read through your web pixel and a server-to-server postback. At scale that holds around 4,200 validated referrals a day, deduped on the referral ID so one partner is credited per handover. If it helps, I can pull the line-by-line referral view for your panel. Worth a short look?
illustrative_flags: 4,200 validated referrals a day (MobUpps-specific daily validated-referral volume; illustrative, never an established result)
register_notes: Stage 1 Australian English, native register, no transliteration (Latin script). References prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (cost-per-sale + provider-confirmed validated referral via web pixel and S2S postback + referral-ID dedupe). ONE illustrative figure (4,200 validated referrals a day, flagged). Soft CTA, exactly one question mark; no sign-off; no em dash; no curly quotes; no hedge before a number; 'X, not Y' avoided; brands only from candidate set (none named here).
